about: scripts/perf-guard.py, live part: haxeon run --watch, patching, on tests/perf/live-project (small) and on the app template over haxeon-ui (ui), from the save of an edit to the running app's patch-applied event, with the CLI and server built ahead of time (haxeon-aot, aot_). Measured on Linux x86-64. Tolerances are fractions of the value (tolerance) or counts (tolerance_abs).

aot_small_body_edit_ms.why: Median save-to-applied wall of a body edit of the small program. Wall varies with the machine's load, so only a wait added on the edit's path (a poll, a write, a collection, work left from the last request) fails it.

aot_small_signature_edit_ms.why: Save-to-applied wall of a changed static signature in the small program, which recompiles its callers and patches an adapter in; loose for the same reason.

aot_ui_body_edit_ms.why: Median save-to-applied wall of a body edit of the UI app, whose program is mostly haxeon-ui. Wall varies with the machine's load, so only a wait added on the edit's path (a poll, a write, a collection, work left from the last request) fails it.

aot_ui_signature_edit_ms.why: Save-to-applied wall of a changed static signature in the UI app, whose program is mostly haxeon-ui, which recompiles its callers and patches an adapter in; loose for the same reason.

small_body_edit_functions.why: The functions the body edit's patch carries, which the runtime compiles: the edited one and what it is inlined into. Deterministic.

small_signature_edit_functions.why: The edited function, its callers and the adapter: deterministic.

ui_body_edit_functions.why: The functions the body edit's patch carries, which the runtime compiles: the edited one and what it is inlined into. Deterministic.

ui_signature_edit_functions.why: The edited function, its callers and the adapter: deterministic.

aot_small_server_live_bytes.why: The server's live data after the growth session's last edit: what a live session keeps. From the heap census that ends each build (`write-done`, after a full collection): the bytes of the live blocks, which do not move with the collector's fragmentation or the machine (three runs agree to the census's 0.1 MB step; a run on four cores from a longer path too). The mapped pages beside them are printed, not compared. The slack is two and a half of those steps.

aot_small_server_live_growth_bytes.why: Live data growth over the growth session's edits after those that fill the session, from the same census. A live session must keep about what a plain one keeps; growth here is history kept per revision. The slack is two and a half of the census's 0.1 MB steps.

aot_ui_server_live_bytes.why: The server's live data after the growth session's last edit: what a live session keeps. From the heap census that ends each build (`write-done`, after a full collection): the bytes of the live blocks, which do not move with the collector's fragmentation or the machine (three runs agree to the census's 0.1 MB step; a run on four cores from a longer path too). The mapped pages beside them are printed, not compared. The slack is about five of those steps.

aot_ui_server_live_growth_bytes.why: Live data growth over the growth session's edits after those that fill the session, from the same census. A live session must keep about what a plain one keeps; growth here is history kept per revision. The growth session resumes the history the timed session recorded, and keeps about 0.7 MB more with each of its last three edits. The slack is five of the census's 0.1 MB steps.
